answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 76 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an atlas bet on surviving 76 epochs of grading, and every onyx settlement recomputes the vine schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
